verdict.reason: The finding's load-bearing claims are false. (1) "No test exercises a BlockMarker at all" — packages/slides/test/export/pptx/round-trip.test.ts:154-166 ("text box with lineHeight, marL/indent, highlight, and bullet marker round-trips") exports fixture slide 7, which carries <a:buClr><a:srgbClr val="FF0000"/></a:buClr>, buSzPts 1200 and buFont Arial (packages/slides/test/import/pptx/__fixtures__/build-rich-pptx.ts:387-423), through exportPptx -> markerToXml and re-imports it. normalize()'s normalizeBlock (packages/slides/test/export/pptx/normalize.ts:184-198) only deletes marginTop/marginBottom and zeroes id — block.marker (color/fontSize/fontFamily) is included in the toEqual, so the buClr branch at text.ts:134 is executed and a silent regression that dropped buClr would fail that test. (2) hasColor is one shared helper (text.ts:180-182); its ''-is-unset behavior is directly asserted at packages/slides/test/export/pptx/text.test.ts:87-107. The only uncovered slice is the marker.color === '' variant of an already-asserted helper at one of its four call sites — under this lens that is "coverage could be broader but the core behavior is tested" (minor/nit), not a behavior change shipped with no meaningful test.

finding.summary: Underline-color '' fallback changed with no test covering it
finding.evidence: The delta changed `ctx.strokeStyle = resolveColor(style.underlineColor) ?? textColor` to `resolveStoredColor(resolveColor, style.underlineColor) ?? textColor` (paint-layout.ts:453). That is a real behavior change: pre-change an `underlineColor: ''` assigned '' to strokeStyle (silently ignored by canvas, inheriting whatever stroke color the previous pass left), post-change it falls back to the run's text color. No test exercises it: grepping `underlineColor` across packages/docs finds hits only in src (types.ts, text-editor.ts, paint-layout.ts) and never in test/. The added #728 tests cover only text color (paint-layout.test.ts 'renderRun cleared text color'), list markers (render-list-marker.test.ts), table cell text/markers (table-renderer.test.ts) and the helper itself (model/color.test.ts) — none set `underlineColor`. paint-layout.test.ts already has a stroke-recording ctx (`makeStrokeCtx`, asserts `s.color`), so a test would be cheap.

verdict.reason: The claimed-missing test exists. packages/docs/test/view/paint-layout.test.ts:220-245 has a dedicated `describe('renderRun cleared underline color (issue #728)')` block with three cases built via the `underlinedRun()` helper (L210-218): (1) `underlineColor: ''` with `color: '#ff0000'` asserts the underline is stroked in '#ff0000' (L225-229), (2) `underlineColor: ''` with no run color asserts `Theme.defaultColor` (L232-237), (3) explicit `underlineColor: '#00ff00'` still overrides the text color (L239-244). These directly exercise the changed line paint-layout.ts:453. The tests are non-vacuous: `makeStrokeCtx` (L69-104) stores `strokeStyle` verbatim via a real setter and pushes it at each `stroke()` (L82-83, L97-99), so under the pre-change `resolveColor(style.underlineColor) ?? textColor` the recorded color would be '' and cases 1 and 2 would fail. The reviewer's grep evidence is demonstrably wrong — `underlineColor` appears at test/view/paint-layout.test.ts lines 211, 221, 225, 233, 239, 240 — and their read range (100-210) stopped one line short of the block.
